title: SegTSim: A Big Data Driven Segmented Temporal Simulation Framework for Heterogeneous Multivariate Systems
abstract: arXiv:2609.22192v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Heterogeneous multivariate time-series systems exhibit segment-specific nonlinear dynamics that challenge monolithic forecasting architectures. We propose SegTSim, a big-data-driven segmented temporal simulation framework that integrates segment-specific elasticity modeling with adaptive min-gating, dynamic production relocation optimization, multi-factor data fusion with exchange-rate propagation, and a deep ensemble validation pipeline. The framework is validated on US--Japan automotive trade data from USITC repositories spanning 2015 to 2025, comprising approximately 13000 annual records. Under a 25% perturbation scenario, Japanese import volume declines by 20.4% to 0.93 billion USD, while all output variables maintain coefficients of variation below 3.5% across 1000 ensemble inference runs.

translated_title: SegTSim：一种面向异构多变量系统的大数据驱动分段时序仿真框架
translated_abstract: 异构多变量时间序列系统表现出特定于分段的非线性动态，这对整体式的预测架构构成了挑战。我们提出了SegTSim，一个大数据驱动的分段时序仿真框架，它集成了分段特定弹性建模与自适应最小门控、动态生产转移优化、带汇率传导的多因子数据融合，以及深度集成验证流水线。该框架在美国国际贸易委员会（USITC）数据库中2015年至2025年的美日汽车贸易数据上进行了验证，共包含约13000条年度记录。在25%扰动情景下，日本进口量下降20.4%至9.3亿美元，同时在1000次集成推理运行中，所有输出变量的变异系数均保持在3.5%以下。
tldr: 提出大数据驱动的分段时序仿真框架SegTSim，通过分段弹性建模、自适应最小门控、动态生产转移优化与深度集成验证，在美日汽车贸易数据上实现了对异构多变量系统稳健可靠的仿真预测。
en_tdlr: SegTSim is a big-data-driven segmented temporal simulation framework that integrates segment-specific elasticity modeling, adaptive min-gating, dynamic production relocation optimization, and deep ensemble validation to achieve robust forecasting for heterogeneous multivariate time-series systems, validated on US–Japan automotive trade data.
